from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FeeRecord(BaseModel):
    """A record of court fees (first or second instance) including total and allocation."""
    stage: str | None = Field(description="Instance level, e.g. '一审', '二审'")
    total_amount: str | None = Field(description="Total fee amount string, e.g. '150 元', '109939.38 元'")
    allocation: list[str] = Field(description="List of strings describing how the fee is split/borne, e.g. '林某负担 97846.05 元'")

class JudgmentOutcome(BaseModel):
    """Extracted evidence from a single judgment document for matching against options."""
    court_name: str | None = Field(description="The court issuing the judgment, e.g. '广东省广州市天河区人民法院'")
    case_number: str | None = Field(description="The case identification number, e.g. '（2022）粤 0106 民初 40451 号'")
    parties_involved: list[str] = Field(description="List of party names mentioned in the judgment (e.g. '林某', '某某公司甲')")
    appeal_disposition: str | None = Field(description="The decision on the appeal, e.g. '驳回上诉，维持原判'")
    monetary_judgment: str | None = Field(description="Any specific money payment ordered (amount + condition), e.g. '148 万元及其利息'")
    final_statement: str | None = Field(description="Statement about finality, e.g. '本判决为终审判决'")
    fee_records: list[FeeRecord] = Field(description="All fee records found in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgments: list[JudgmentOutcome]
